purpose: Teach: 彗星/五感/血統/農作物/和音/帰結/筋力/教祖

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、彗星観測の天文学史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you covered comet observation and the history of astronomy in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, attentive opening. Light curiosity in the voice — genuinely interested in her work. Even pace, encouraging. Teacher leaning in slightly, full presence.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、五感統合の認知科学を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote about cognitive science and multisensory integration.
lines.style: Clear and direct, a touch of pride underneath. Not defensive, just honest. Steady eye contact. The answer of someone who stands by their work.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 王朝の血統継承を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You addressed dynastic succession and bloodline inheritance, didn't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Gentle confirmation rather than interrogation. Soft, reflective tone. Listening more than correcting.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、温暖化と農作物への影響を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on climate change and its effects on agricultural yields.
lines.style: Steady and substantive. A note of seriousness about the subject matter. Not rushed. The tone of someone offering something they've given real thought to.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 音楽理論の和音解析を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You explored music theory and harmonic analysis in your paper, right?
lines.style: Engaged and present. A slight lift in tone — this is a subject that interests her too. Collaborative rather than interrogative. Leaning in with genuine curiosity.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、社会運動の論理的帰結を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I examined the logical consequences of social movements.
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful response. Weight given to each word. Not hurried. The answer of someone thinking through something complex but grounded.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 加齢に伴う筋力減少を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You took on muscle loss associated with aging in your research, didn't you?
lines.style: Gentle, curious. Warmth underneath. Not a quiz — a real question. Slight tilt forward in posture, encouraging her to continue. Open, steady pace.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、新興宗教の教祖研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote about new religious movements and the study of their leaders.
lines.style: Direct and clear. A slight settling into the answer — confidence without fanfare. The closing note of someone who has completed something substantial. Calm finish.
